name: Heartbreak
doc: Heartbreak (Creeps' enemy attack; the act family, Drain's master): once its children are gone the actor pools and the stage light ramp up, then one emitter per action - its sound, two screen flashes, a heart, a ring, an arrow flying to the target and a burst, sparks, the actor system, the master's release, the damage; after the last action a wait, the light ramp down. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag031_heartbreak.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the stage in task; after the last action its wait, the stage out task; the actor counters cleared every tick

pools.doc: the heart, the ring, the arrow and the burst (the port's)
the spark spawner, sparks and the shake task (the port's)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the screen flashes, the actor system, the master's release, the damage; the master's wait

parts.title: Stage light
parts.doc: The stage light ramps up (once the master's children are gone) and down (after the wait)

groups.label: Actor system
groups.doc: At the emitter's start: Start, Length (ticks), Mode (0: the targets' positions)

params.label: First flash
params.doc: A screen flash at this tick

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage of the action's target from this tick

params.label: Wait
params.doc: After the last action, the light ramp down after these ticks

params.label: Level
params.doc: Its level (up to it, then down from it)

params.label: Step
params.doc: Up / down by this a tick

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sound, the screen flashes, the prim-model tasks, the actor system, the master's release, the damage.
The stage light ramp up (the port's task: the four stage light words up a step a tick).
The stage light ramp down (the port's task: from its level down a step a tick to 0).
